instruction.text: Choose the sum that matches the story.

atoms.a: Julia needs to buy some milk on her way to hockey practice. She needs to cycle 0.73 kilometres to the shop and then a further 1.2 kilometres to the hockey field. How many kilometres does Julia need to cycle in total?

hint.text: The number in the gap is the answer to the addition sum above.

atoms.b: Julia needs to cycle <mat><gap>1.93</gap></mat> kilometres in total.

instruction.text: Choose the sum that matches the story.

atoms.a: Lewis buys a pencil case for £1.37. He gives the cashier £1.50. How much change does Lewis get?

hint.text: The number in the gap is the answer to the subtraction sum above.

instruction.text: Drag the numbers and symbols to create a sum that matches the story.

atoms.a: Malik is doing a science experiment. He needs to add <mat>2.2</mat> millilitres of food colouring and <mat>1.45</mat> millilitres of washing up liquid to some milk. How many millilitres does Malik have to add in total?

hint.text: The number in the gap is the answer to the addition sum above.

atoms.b: Malik has to add <mat><gap>3.65</gap></mat> millilitres to his experiment in total.

instruction.text: Drag the numbers and symbols to create a sum that matches the story.

atoms.a: Anjali has a piece of wool that is <mat>9.85</mat> cm long. She cuts <mat>4.3</mat> cm off the wool. How long is the wool now?

hint.text: The number in the gap is the answer to the subtraction sum above.

atoms.b: The wool is now <mat><gap>5.55</gap></mat> cm long.
